source.datasheet: SLVSAM2E, Rev E, May 2017 with current package appendix

assumptions: Package centered at native/CPL origin, manufacturer top-view pin 1 at top left, no rotation or translation error
Nominal terminal dimensions are midpoint of min/max; they are a constructed comparison case, not a separate TI nominal specification
Dimension-only grid does not apply composite positional tolerance, PCB fabrication or assembly placement error
Two terminal variants: rectangular envelope and the drawing alternative with inward semicircle; results do not assert JLC uses either variant
Overlap uses intersection/lead area, matching captured JLC help. JLC terminal polygon, selected pin and registration are not available; intersection/land is a separate diagnostic only.

stencil.scope: Read-only design geometry check. Roundrect dimensions plus perimeter samples verify containment; actual stencil thickness/release, solder volume, placement, EP wetting and voiding remain assembly-process qualifications.

supplier_rule.ratio_definition: lead/pad intersection area divided by lead area
supplier_rule.P3_evidence: P3 SMT category counts match corrected-CPL P2; native U2 copper/paste and pose are unchanged

aperture11_candidates.F.Paste: 0.90 x 0.70 R0.05 exposed-pad paste window, two U2 flashes

split_stencil_recognition_evidence.interpretation: Strong numerical and aperture/component-association evidence of a split-paste-window being compared to full exposed-pad lead; not proof of the JLC i274x source-file mapping
split_stencil_recognition_evidence.caution: Aperture numbers are file-local. F.Cu ADD11 is a signal land, whereas F.Paste ADD11 is this EP window. The object name alone cannot select a source file. The denominator cases are explicit geometric hypotheses; the actual package/model EP shape and tolerance are not known.
